title: Phase 4 transition request, result, owner approval, G-OQ8 decision and story completion
description: Runtime uses stdlib closed validation. evaluate is candidate evidence; consume authenticates a completed run. A PASS is an assurance subcondition only. Approval request_sha256 excludes approvals to permit posting references after approval. No caller-provided command is accepted. A gate decision reports one authenticated consumption for G-OQ8 governing-design availability only; saved decisions are never authority for later consumption. Release/promotion use the fixed publication-authority-v1 adapter, requiring exact record, sole profile, independent composing coverage and owner codec inputs; unavailable fixed prerequisites refuse.
